name: Indian River County, FL
findings: Indian River County has 682 nonprofit organizations. 248 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 194 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Indian River County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few hobby and sports organizations list public events
observations.text: 5 hobby and sports organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 12 would.

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through hobby and sports groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 106 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 106 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
